key_impacts: COVID-19 cases escalated nationally leading to a more serious local situation.
Movement Control Order imposed nationwide in phases from 18 March to 12 May 2020.
Major events, including APSTCDRR 2020, were cancelled due to the pandemic.
evidence_snippets: First COVID-19 case in Malaysia reported 14 January 2020.
First domestic case on 5 February 2020; cases have escalated.
MCO phases ran 18–31 March, 1–14 April, 15–28 April, and 29 April–12 May 2020.
